verdict: The R6 answer-only invocation is ready. The short prompt is self-contained, requires exactly one fenced apply_patch diff, permits only the two intended existing source/test files, and embeds eleven byte-exact excerpts from the frozen R3 source preimages. It preserves the same repair scope and destination as the explicitly approved R5 payload while removing unrelated context. The launcher independently verifies every hash-bound input, the empty disposable cwd, the stopped R5 process, and all three source/fixture/test preimages before exec. It uses explicit grok-4.6/xhigh/default settings, one single-turn output, no plan or subagents, disabled web search, and deny rules for Read/Edit/Bash/Grep/MCPTool(*); GROK_WRITE_FILE=0 and GROK_SUBAGENTS=0 add process-level write/subagent guards. No static blocker was found; the only remaining condition is the coordinator's immediate prelaunch recheck of the launcher/prompt/preimage hashes, source-root baseline, output-path absence and authorization scope.
